description: Governs when and how replay is used in healing convergence loops. Replay is a healing primitive, not a shortcut — all governance gates still execute.

SEMANTIC_REPAIR_RERUN.trigger: LLM-generated code fails semantic validation (FORBIDDEN pattern used, REQUIRED pattern missing)
SEMANTIC_REPAIR_RERUN.replay_cost_reduction: HIGH — skips NuGet download (30-120s), DLL reflection (10-30s)
replay_safe_conditions: catalog hash matches denominator (same package version)
per_type_constraints unchanged since prior run (constraints_hash matches)
no new allowed_types added since prior run
replay_unsafe_conditions: per_type_constraints changed (REQUIRED/FORBIDDEN patterns updated) — must downgrade to validation
NuGet package version changed — must start from nuget_fetch
LLM non-determinism: new generation will differ from prior; this is expected and acceptable
SEMANTIC_REPAIR_RERUN.escalation: If 3+ consecutive generation replays fail semantic validation — file PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED taskcard

VALIDATOR_FIX.trigger: dotnet build or runtime failure; prior generation code exists and is semantically valid
VALIDATOR_FIX.replay_cost_reduction: VERY_HIGH — skips infra (60-150s) AND generation (30-90s LLM tokens)
replay_safe_conditions: generated project dirs exist with non-empty Program.cs
replay_unsafe_conditions: Program.cs missing or empty — must regenerate (cannot replay validation)
Package version changed — infra replay unsafe, must start from nuget_fetch
VALIDATOR_FIX.escalation: If build fails after validation replay — check if per_type_constraints changed; consider generation replay

REVIEWER_RERUN.trigger: Need 2nd consecutive reviewer PASS (e.g., pdf-optimizer REVIEWED state); prior validation passed
REVIEWER_RERUN.replay_cost_reduction: VERY_HIGH — skips infra + generation + full dotnet build+run cycle
replay_safe_conditions: prior validation results exist and are passing
generated project dirs exist with non-empty Program.cs
replay_unsafe_conditions: validation_results.json missing — must replay from validation
reviewer available=False in prior run — copy_reviewer_evidence will block publisher
gate verdict not in publishable range — publisher blocked (correct behavior)
REVIEWER_RERUN.escalation: If reviewer FAIL after 2 replays — escalate to generation replay with updated constraints

PUBLICATION_RETRY.trigger: Publisher failed due to transient error (API rate limit, token expiry); prior reviewer passed
PUBLICATION_RETRY.replay_cost_reduction: MAXIMUM — skips all stages except publisher
replay_safe_conditions: gate verdict in PUBLISHABLE_VERDICTS (PR_DRY_RUN_READY | PR_READY | FULL_E2E_PASSED | PARTIAL_*)
GITHUB_TOKEN (classic ghp_ PAT, repo scope) set
replay_unsafe_conditions: reviewer available=False — HARD FAIL, blocked by copy_reviewer_evidence()
gate verdict not publishable — HARD FAIL
stale denominator — WARN (not hard fail, but log alert)
PUBLICATION_RETRY.escalation: If publisher replay fails — investigate live GitHub API; do not retry more than 2x

LLM_NONDETERMINISM_POLICY.description: Generation replay is explicitly LLM-nondeterministic. New code will differ from prior run.
LLM_NONDETERMINISM_POLICY.safety_note: This is acceptable: the new code is still subject to full semantic validation, dotnet build+run, and reviewer gates. No stale code is used.
unsafe_for: Reproducing an exact prior passing example for debugging — use the original run directory instead
Comparing generated code diffs — use git diff on generated/ dir between runs
LLM_NONDETERMINISM_POLICY.downgrade_trigger: If generation replay produces code that consistently fails semantic validation after 2+ attempts — update per_type_constraints and rerun

replay_escalation_ladder.use_when: transient publish failure, reviewer evidence fresh
code exists but dotnet build/run failed
code invalid semantically; infra artifacts valid
catalog stale, package changed, or extraction invalid

replay_governance_invariants: scenario_planning NEVER skipped — denominator governance enforced in all modes
completeness gate ALWAYS runs — no scenario can disappear without explicit cause
publisher replay BLOCKED if reviewer available=False
publisher replay BLOCKED if gate verdict not in publishable range
catalog hash ALWAYS verified — hard fail on mismatch
stale-artifact-check.json ALWAYS written before raising errors
replay lineage recorded in replay-manifest.json for auditability
